key_factors: P/E of 54.5x as of 2026-04-23, near the top of its 32.4–55.3x 1-year range, up from ~32.6x a year ago — a 67% multiple expansion with no commensurate acceleration in earnings growth
P/B of 11.8x, also near the top of its 8.2–11.9x range, indicating the market is pricing in significant future margin expansion
FY2027 EPS guidance of $2.75–$2.85 came in below the $2.96 consensus, and management pre-guided for lower Q1 operating income growth due to tariff timing
Net margin compressed to 2.8% in recent quarters (from 3.6% a year ago), while the stock has re-rated to a tech-like multiple — a dangerous combination
Grocery market share continues to erode: down from 20.4% in 2024 to 19.9% in 2026 per Numerator data
Rising oil prices ($99/bbl, up 64% over the period) and elevated 10Y yields (4.34%) create a challenging macro backdrop for a low-margin, high-volume retailer
Q1 FY2027 earnings expected ~May 14, 2026 — management has already pre-guided for tariff headwinds, creating downside risk at an already stretched valuation
